name: EX-19 Peacekeeping & Stabilisation — 5 Days
description: 5-day UN-style peacekeeping and stabilisation operations exercise in a post-conflict environment. Covers patrol operations, force protection, civilian interaction, rule of law support, disarmament monitoring, humanitarian coordination, and reporting to UN mandate authority. Working hours with overnight rest periods. Suitable for UN peacekeeping battalions, multinational force exercises, and stability operations staff.

groups.name: UN Civilian Affairs
groups.description: UN civilian affairs and political advisers

layers.name: UN Civilian
layers.description: UN civilian activities and political reporting

items.title: Mission Brief — UN Mandate
items.description: Force Commander briefs all units on UN mandate (Chapter VII), rules of engagement, use of force authority, impartiality obligations, civilian protection priorities, reporting requirements, and coordination with UN Mission HQ. Rules of Engagement card issued.

items.title: Zone Alpha Patrol — Vehicle & Foot
items.description: Peacekeeping Force A conducts routine vehicle patrol in Zone Alpha. Population interaction: 3 community leader meetings conducted. Disarmament checkpoint: 2 illegal weapons surrendered voluntarily. Incident reports filed. Village elder concerns about food distribution recorded and forwarded to UN Civilian Affairs.

items.title: UN Civilian — Community Liaison
items.description: UN Civilian Affairs team meets local government representatives, community leaders, and NGO partners. Topics: reconstruction progress, land dispute mediation, return of displaced persons, upcoming local elections support. 3 formal meeting reports filed for UN Mission HQ.

items.title: INJECT: Armed Group Checkpoint Standoff
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: Peacekeeping Force B patrol encounters illegal armed checkpoint manned by 8 armed individuals blocking main supply route. ROE assessment: use of force not yet authorised. Negotiation team deployed. UN Civilian Affairs adviser called forward. Force HQ notified. Situation managed through negotiation — checkpoint dismantled after 90 minutes.

items.title: INJECT: Civilian Protection Emergency
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: Report of armed group threatening civilians in village 4km from Force B sector. Force Protection authorisation: use of force to protect civilians authorised under mandate. QRF dispatched. Armed group withdraws on approach of peacekeeping force. 340 civilians evacuated to safe area.

items.title: Daily UN SITREP
items.description: Force HQ compiles and submits daily SITREP to UN Mission HQ. Format: J2 (intelligence), J3 (operations), J5 (civil-military), civilian casualties, human rights observations, security incidents, force readiness. Submitted via encrypted UN communications system.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: ENDEX declared. All exercise activities terminated. Force units return to base. Final exercise reports compiled. Civilian affairs products archived.

items.title: Peacekeeping Operations AAR
items.description: Full multi-national AAR. Topics: ROE application, civilian interaction, crisis response decision-making, UN reporting quality, force protection vs mandate implementation, inter-contingent coordination, language/interpretation challenges.
